'''Thorus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith officer|Sith-Imperial officer]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Thorus was responsible for the execution of hundreds of civilians and full-scale bombings on unarmed populations. These actions were committed in circumvention to the direct commands of [[Imperial High Command (Sith Empire)|Imperial High Command]]. Thorus regretted his actions, but he continued his service to the Empire.

{{GameLS}}
In [[3643 BBY]], the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|CO]] of [[Havoc Squad]] ran into Colonel Thorus, an Imperial officer [[Elara Dorne|Elara]] was familiar with. Once Thorus gave the information Havoc needed, Elara advised executing him to prevent him from committing any more atrocities. However, the lieutenant let Thorus go. Thorus was pleased and possibly left the Empire for everything he committed.
{{Endgame}}
